title: QA Audit: Security Review, Test Coverage Verification & GitHub Auto-Push
description: Independent quality assurance gate. Audit all git diffs from T-101 through T-104 for security vulnerabilities, logic flaws, contract compliance, and test coverage. Upon APPROVED verdict, auto-commit with Conventional Commits and push to GitHub remote under divyprj.
acceptance_criteria: SCOPE AUDIT: Verify no worker modified files outside their write_scope via `git diff --name-only`
CONTRACT AUDIT: Verify contracts.ts was not modified by any worker (checksum comparison)
SECURITY: No hardcoded secrets, tokens, or credentials in source code
SECURITY: All SQL queries use parameterized statements (no string interpolation)
SECURITY: Scraper error handling does not leak internal state in API responses
LOGIC: Delta calculations correctly clamp negative track deltas to 0
LOGIC: Guest token refresh handles expiration correctly
LOGIC: Rate limiter jitter is truly randomized (not deterministic seed)
TYPES: All imports from contracts.ts match the locked interface definitions
COVERAGE: Pre-flight verification commands pass for T-101, T-102, T-103

On APPROVED: Execute `git add -A && git commit -m 'feat(core): DHH Pulse v1 — scraper, analytics, dashboard' && gh repo create dhh-pulse --private --source=. --remote=origin --push` (or push to existing remote)
Output detailed audit report to .agent-state/tasks/T-105-audit.md with APPROVED or REJECTED verdict
qa_feedback: Security, architecture, and code quality audit PASSED with verdict: APPROVED. Zero vulnerabilities found.
